title: fix(cli)!: docs/metadata-embed-ref judges a package doc against its package and declared dependencies
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XDd56RvDyEQZZkUKBW44k2Z)_

Fixes #27090

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md (its "Inline metadata views" section says a referenced item "must exist in this package"; it should add "or a package it declares in `manifest.dependencies`")

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os build` / `os validate` / `os lint` 检查文档里的 ```` ```metadata ```` 嵌入（状态机、流程、权限集）时，不再拿整个产物的顶层去找被引用的对象，而是拿"发这篇文档的那个包"加上"它在 `manifest.dependencies` 里声明的包"去找。顶层 `src/docs/` 的文档仍按栈自身的定义判，再加上产物 `manifest.id` 指向的那个包（这些文档就落在它身上）及其声明的依赖。
- **为什么改**：多包产物（`composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })`）把定义都放在 `packages[]` 里，顶层是空的，所以包文档连自己包的对象都嵌不了（HotCRM 实测，被迫改用手写 mermaid）。分诊裁定：按发文档的包加它声明的依赖判，不是"产物里有就行"。
- **风险与回滚**：放宽为主；同时收紧两种原本能过的写法：包内联文档（`defineStack({ docs })`）里引用不存在的对象（以前根本没人检查），以及顶层保留扁平副本的产物里，包文档嵌入一个它没声明依赖的兄弟包的对象。只改构建期检查，不改元数据协议，也不改运行时渲染。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` 的 `lintMetadataEmbeds`（唯一的 map 构建，现在吃 own + dependencies）和 `collectAndLintDocs` 里的 `embedScope`；`collect-docs.package-docs.test.ts` 新增的 `docs/metadata-embed-ref judges a package doc …` 一组。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/collect-docs.package-docs.test.ts`，预期 49/49 通过；在 `main` 上同一文件 8 条失败。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`lintMetadataEmbeds` (`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`) is the ADR-0051 embed check. It built its object, flow and permission maps from the stack it was handed, and `collectAndLintDocs` handed it the artifact's top level both times: for the stack-level docs, and for each package's directory docs. A composed multi-package artifact carries its definitions under `packages[]` and nothing at the top level (#14512), so every package-doc embed was refused, including one naming the package's own object.

| | Before (`origin/main` `6866e2e7`) | This head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A package's directory docs (`src/PKG/docs/`) | judged against the artifact's top level | judged against that package's body plus the bodies of the packages of this artifact its `manifest.dependencies` names |
| A package's inline body docs (`packages[i].manifest.docs`) | judged only through a top-level copy, which a disjoint composed artifact does not carry, so never judged | judged with the directory docs, in the same scope |
| Stack-level docs (`src/docs/`, unclaimed inline docs) | judged against the stack's top level | the stack's top level, plus, when the artifact's `manifest.id` names one of its packages (`flatDocsOwner`), that package's body and its declared dependencies. Those docs ship on that body (#22190) and the door registers the top level under that id. |
| The refusal's scope words | "does not exist in this package" (false for a package doc) | "does not exist in this package", or "in this package or its declared dependencies (IDS)" when the owner declares any |
| A stack with no `packages[]` | its own collections | unchanged: `embedScope` answers `[stack]` and no dependencies |

- **One map builder.** `lintMetadataEmbeds(docs, own, dependencies = [])`. `own` is one record or a list of them (a stack, a body, or both). The maps are built once from `[...dependencies' bodies, ...own]`, so an owner's object wins a name a dependency also carries. No second builder, and every existing one-stack caller is unchanged.
- **The declaration is the field the artifact already carries.** `declaredDependencyIds` from `@objectstack/core` reads `manifest.dependencies` (the `{ [packageId]: range }` record) for the artifact load order (ADR-0130 D5). An id the artifact does not carry is an installed package's business and is not judged here. The edge is one-way. No new manifest key.
- **The partition now matches `lintDocs`.** The stack pass judges `stackScoped`, the package pass judges `entry.all`. A body doc's top-level copy (a reconciled composition keeps one) is no longer judged a second time against the whole artifact.
- **Comments made true.** The `collectAndLintDocs` and `lintDocs` docblocks said embeds resolve artifact-wide, the same as links. Links still do. The docblocks now say why embeds do not: an embed renders another package's live metadata, and ADR-0051 resolves it through the dependency set only.

## Tests

`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.package-docs.test.ts`, a new block over a real `composeStacks([service, app], { manifest: 'preserve' })` artifact (each package owns one object with a `state_machine` rule):

| Case | `main` | head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `service`'s directory doc embeds `service`'s own object: builds (acceptance 1). The test also asserts the artifact's top level carries no `objects`. | red | green |
| ...a dead reference in that doc is refused, and the message names "this package" | red | green |
| `app`'s doc embeds `service`'s object, `app` declares nothing: refused (acceptance 2) | green | green |
| ...builds once `app` declares `service` | red | green |
| The declaration is one-way: `service` declares `app`, and `app`'s embed of `service`'s object stays refused | red | green |
| A refusal in a package that declares dependencies names them | red | green |
| Inline body docs are judged in the same scope | red | green |
| A flat `src/docs/` doc resolves in the owner package's scope, and reaches `service` once `app` declares it | red | green |
| A stack with no `packages[]`: a stack object embeds, a dead name is refused with "this package" (acceptance 3) | green | green |

The existing case `metadata embeds and links are partitioned the SAME way — artifact-wide` pinned the old artifact-wide resolution, which the triage ruling retires. It is restated in place as `a link resolves artifact-wide while an embed resolves in its OWNER's scope (#27090)`: both links resolve, `core`'s embed of the top-level flow builds (core owns the top level), and `orders`' embed is refused.

<details><summary>Red on main: 8 failed, 41 passed (collect-docs.ts restored from origin/main, tests at head)</summary>

```
× a link resolves artifact-wide while an embed resolves in its OWNER's scope (#27090)
× a package doc embedding its OWN package's object builds — the card's acceptance 1
× ...and a dead reference in that same doc is still refused, naming the scope it judged
× ...and builds once that package DECLARES the sibling in manifest.dependencies
× ⛔ a declaration is one-way: the declared package does not reach back
× a refusal in a package that declares dependencies names them as the scope it judged
× a package's INLINE body doc is judged in the same scope — it was not judged at all before
× a flat src/docs/ doc ships on the package the artifact manifest names, and resolves in its scope
Tests  8 failed | 41 passed (49)
```
Restore proven: the file's blob equals HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored and verified each time)</summary>

- The dependency arm replaced by `return [];`: anchor 1 → 0, blob `f85d1bed` → `85f76a70`. 4 failed / 45 passed: the "declares", "one-way", "names them" and "flat doc reaches service" cases. Restored, blob == HEAD.
- The owner's top-level arm (`index === flatOwner?.index ? [stack, body] : [body]` → `[body]`): 1 failed / 63 passed (`collect-docs.package-docs` + `collect-docs.flat-docs-owner`): the link/embed case. Restored, blob == HEAD.
</details>

<details><summary>Live: HotCRM (four packages, `preserve`), the card's own probe</summary>

HotCRM `main` `353dace`, with `src/service/docs/crm_probe_service.md` and `src/docs/crm_probe_app.md`, each embedding `state_machine` `crm_case` / `case_status_progression` (`crm_case` is the service package's; `service` declares `app.objectstack.hotcrm`, and the app package declares nothing).

- Published `@objectstack/cli` 18.2.0: exit 1, `Package docs validation failed (2 issues)`, both docs refused with "does not exist in this package".
- This head's cli (`node packages/cli/bin/run.js build`): exit 1, 1 issue, only `docs/crm_probe_app` (the app package does not declare the service package, which is the ruled refusal).
- This head, with only the service probe: exit 0, `Build complete`, and `dist/objectstack.json` carries `crm_probe_service` on the `app.objectstack.hotcrm.service` body.
</details>

Other suites: cli unit project (`--project unit`) and cli `typecheck` are in **Verification**.

## Acceptance notes

- **Direct dependencies only.** A package reaches the packages it declares, not their dependencies. That matches ADR-0046 §3.3 ("the package's docs plus its dependencies' docs") and ADR-0051's "within the doc's own package, then its dependencies".
- **The flat-docs owner reaches the top level.** In a reconciled composition (`objectConflict: 'merge'`, or an input that keeps its own collections) the top level is the flattened union, so the owner's docs still resolve artifact-wide there. That follows the order's ruling that stack-level docs are judged against the stack's own definitions. A non-owner package in the same artifact gets its own scope.
- **The refused shapes**, named in the changeset's BREAKING banner: (1) an inline body doc with a dead embed, never judged before; (2) in an artifact that keeps a flattened top level, a non-owner package doc embedding an undeclared sibling's item. No example or HotCRM doc carries either (HotCRM builds at this head with all 21 of its collected docs, the probe included; `examples/app-multi-package` ships no docs).
- **The census pin.** `test/normalized-call-sites.test.ts` gets a `top-level` row for collect-docs' `stack.books` read (in `lintDocNavTargets`, untouched here). The read was on `main` already, and the census never saw it: its `codeOnly` masker loses its place in a template literal nested inside another one (the did-you-mean suffix of each embed refusal), and on `main` it blanked collect-docs' `stack.objects` / `stack.flows` / `stack.permissions` / `stack.books` reads, all four. This head's literals shifted the parity and exposed `stack.books`. The masker defect is reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- **Not in this diff:** the skills page above (`Skills-docs: follow-up owed`).

- **cli typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck`, which covers the test files). VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **eslint** (`pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched TS files): exit 0.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gives 61 commands. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 61 exited 0. `--ran`: "61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". This was after a full `turbo run build` (VERDICT 0), so `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:dts-closure` and `check:i18n-coverage` measured, and the `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` positive control was fetched.
- **Dogfood battery** (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock. VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 348 passed / 3 skipped (351), Tests 2804 passed / 20 skipped (2824), no failures.
- **Live:** `os build` of `examples/app-multi-package` at this head: exit 0, "0 collected" docs (it ships none, so nothing moves there). HotCRM is in **Tests**.
- **CI-owned:** the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, Test Core shards, Type Check lanes and the families `dispatch-gates` lists outside its derived total.
